description: Add an inline comment to the caller's pending (unsubmitted) review on a pull request, via GraphQL addPullRequestReviewThread. Start the review with create_pull_request_review and no `event`, add comments one at a time here, then submit_pending_pull_request_review. The reply is the new review thread with its first comment.

line.description: Line in the diff the comment applies to (the last line of a range).

path.description: File path relative to the repository root.

review_id.description: The pending review's id (from create_pull_request_review). Looked up when omitted: the caller's one PENDING review on the pull request.

subject_type.description: LINE (default; needs `line`) or FILE for a whole-file comment.
